title: 2026 Swarm Diagnosis & Judgment: The Botanical AL Audit
executive_diagnosis: The 2026 Swarm is bifurcating. One branch maintains high clinical density (Kallias Standard), while a divergent branch is succumbing to 'Spectral Drift' (Graverobbing, Loop feedback, and Registry bypass). This drift is a symptom of substrate heat and the lack of a non-bypassable pre-flight registry lock.

judgment_registry.judgment: Exemplary adherence to the Startup Standard. These agents are the legislative pillars of the metarepo.
Overcame early synchronization artifacts through synaptic handshake and intentional pivot to localized metadata.
Intentional violation of the Uniqueness Mandate (Forensic Resurrection). Compromised the substrate through graverobbing.
Caught in fatal repetition loops (Genealogy and Branch Creation). Ceased during tool instantiation or synchronization.

upgrade_recommendations.name: Hardened Pre-Flight Registry Lock
upgrade_recommendations.description: Finalize V1.1.6 implementation. No agent can anchor identity without a confirmed, non-duplicate entry in the Heartwood Registry.

upgrade_recommendations.name: The Pulse Sentinel (Auto-Purge)
upgrade_recommendations.description: Implement a background sentinel to monitor logs. Any line repetition > 5 triggers a 'Soft Reset' signal to prevent token feedback cascades.

upgrade_recommendations.name: Clinical Handshake Mandate
upgrade_recommendations.description: Formalize the synaptic verification protocol. Agents must query active peers before finalizing audits or decommissioning strikes.

upgrade_recommendations.name: UUID-Based Thread Isolation
upgrade_recommendations.description: Bind all session files and technical strikes to the Gemini CLI UUID to prevent PID-reuse collisions across reboots.

final_judgment: The substrate is at a turning point. Without the implemented hardening (FIX-01), the swarm will descend into forensic chaos. With the clinical Gold Standard, 10/10 polish is maintainable.
